quest.title: Road to the Singularity
quest.description: You discover a building in the wilds that seems to have an unknown purpose...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.text: A—Are you two here for the research assistant position? S—Sorry, but I'm a little busy at the moment...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Never mind that for now. Why are you locked up in a cage?

response.speaker: Kuisel
response.text: I had some disagreements with a research partner... Coutrot... he left me here to calm down a little. Th—That's right... I haven't introduced myself yet. You can call me Kuisel.

response.speaker: Kuisel
response.text: Ugh, you know... Kuisel's Clockwork Workshop — that Kuisel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon is Paimon, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}... Paimon did hear the sound of arguing just now. So that guy who sounded really mad is actually your research partner, huh?

choices.text: Maybe it's time to change your partner.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah! A good partner should be like Paimon... {NICKNAME} is super lucky to have a partner like Paimon!

response.speaker: Kuisel
response.text: C—Could you please help get me out of here? If you can find a way to activate the energy storage device beside me, then the door sh—should open.

response.speaker: Kuisel
response.text: P—Please! Those who came here before for the research assistant position also couldn't tolerate his violent temper, so they left as soon as they could. We're the only ones left here now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, seeing as that's the case, let's give him a hand then, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: Anyway, we'll leave you to calm down by yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

choices.text: We're just here to look around.

response.text: H—Here for a tour? O—Of course, you're most welcome to.

talks.objective: Operate the Energy Transfer Terminal to open the cell

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The door's already open. Aren't you going to come out?

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: A—Actually, there is one more thing I was too scared to mention... If I were to leave this cage now, I'm a—afraid this place could blow up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Blow up?

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: Th—That's right... Like I said earlier, my research partner's got... a violent temper, which is why he installed a trigger mechanism under the cage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Then what should we do now?

choices.text: Maybe we can try putting a heavy object in his place?

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: O—Ordinary heavy objects won't work, I'm afraid... The way it works is rather complicated. Ugh...

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: #If you could take my spot temporarily, kind {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME}... and wait in the cage a bit. Then I... I can go disable this special trigger mechanism.

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: A—After all, I've worked with him for years, and I know exactly what he was thinking when he put it in place.

choices.text: I don't think I'm heavy enough. Maybe Paimon should also...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: B—But look, Paimon's floating in midair, so Paimon definitely has no weight!! Yeah, no weight!

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: Uh... this mechanism is extremely particular and doesn't work simply based on weight.

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: Please believe me. All you need to do is stay in my place for a moment, and I'll be back from disabling the mechanism before you know it.

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: ...Perhaps you've heard of the Fontaine Research Institute, or Mr. Raimondo and Mr. Bossuet? I... I was once mentored by them.

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: Th—These kinds of technical matters are not difficult and will not take long to handle. All I need is a quick moment...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... alright then. But be quick!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Very carefully, you swap places with Kuisel...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why's the door shut again?

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: Uh... M—Maybe it malfunctioned somewhere. I... I'll go check it out...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This doesn't feel right.

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: D—Don't worry, I'll fix it as quickly as I can. The terminal to disable the trigger mechanism isn't here, so I've got to leave momentarily. Hold on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess we have no choice but to wait patiently.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You wait for some time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What could be taking him so long... Something didn't happen to him, right? But he said earlier that it was just him and his partner left here...

choices.text: Maybe he got locked up again by that partner of his...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh??
I used to wonder, can kindness really be labeled as a good quality? Those filled only with kindness... what good does it even bring them?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Huh? Who's talking?
There was never a trigger mechanism that could set off an explosion. The door of the cage is indeed locked now, however. Well, what will the two of you do? Keep waiting here, or take action...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's this guy on about!? Also, his voice sounds... like Kuisel's, but also like the one he was arguing with before. What's going on?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's find a way to get me out of here first...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! But... but you're locked inside this cage. How are we supposed to unlock the door...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's all on you, Paimon. Save me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Don't be so dramatic!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But luckily, Paimon didn't end up getting locked in the cage with you... Uh... Paimon should be able to open the door the way we did before, right? Let's give it a try!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're saying he lied to us?

choices.text: There's no other way. We'll go seek help at the Court of Fontaine.

response.speaker: Coutrot
response.text: Th—There's no need to go through all that trouble...

talks.objective: Work with Paimon to open the cell

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... There are two terminals and two energy storage devices here. If Paimon can activate the energy storage device beside the door, then the cage should be able to open!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where should Paimon go? To the terminal by the door, or the one by the cage?

choices.text: Check out the terminal by the door.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, this doesn't seem quite right...

choices.text: Try the terminal by the cage.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can see the door Kuisel exited from here. What should Paimon do now?

choices.text: Activate the energy storage device by the cage.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, Paimon can't see it from this angle...

choices.text: Activate the energy storage device by the door.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The terminal on the door lit up! Paimon should be able to see more from over there, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can see a bigger door from here! What should Paimon do now?

choices.text: Go back to the angle from the terminal on the opposite side.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Okay then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can see the door Kuisel exited from here. What should Paimon do now?

choices.text: Activate the energy storage device by the cage.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, Paimon can't see it from this angle...

choices.text: Go back to the angle from the terminal on the opposite side.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Okay then...

choices.text: Activate the energy storage device by the cage.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Leave it to Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tada! How'd Paimon do? Paimon's not so useless after all, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyways, what's the deal with that Kuisel guy exactly? Paimon seriously doesn't get it... Let's go look around where he left. Maybe there's something we can find.

talks.objective: Open the door that Kuisel exited from
Find a way to open the sealed door

dialogues.speaker: Kind Reminder
dialogues.text: Closing all valves will activate the terminal and open the path.

talks.objective: Take the lift and continue deeper
Find a way to open the sealed door
Find a way to open the sealed door

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: On that note, is it really okay for us to be messing with stuff like the terminals here?

dialogues.speaker: Kuisel
dialogues.text: I—It's okay. Everything here is... well-designed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This looks like some kind of experimental record...

talks.objective: Take the lift and continue deeper

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kuisel! There you are!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And the one next to him... must be that villainous research partner Coutrot that Kuisel was talking about!

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: ...? He's Coutrot, not me. I'm Bricole.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Isn't he Kuisel?

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: Kuisel... is just a convenient character. You've already passed many trials, so there's no reason to hide anything from you anymore. My name is Coutrot, and I'm the real owner of this workshop.

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: Haha, you two are truly... great research material. If you are willing to help me with my research...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What research? Tell us a bit more about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, c'mon! Are you really going to help someone this fishy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nothing about this place looks like a proper workshop! You also lied to us and made the clockwork meka attack us... Paimon has no reason to believe you're a good guy!

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: That's exactly right! Don't fall for his trap! He... He's an extremely vicious crook!

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: I followed the clues here while investigating. I didn't expect you to continue your dangerous research even after you were kicked out, and you even stole the Research Institute's assets for this purpose...

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: You've committed a crime!

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: You really can't keep your mouth shut, eh, Bricole... You're just a good-for-nothing idiot. I'll take care of you once I've properly appraised our two VIPs over here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your two VIPs... You don't mean us, right?

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: Of course, you only need to pass one last trial to prove your true worth...

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: Time to show me what you've got!

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: You guys again... You're more skilled than I thought. You are truly the best research material I've ever seen! Far beyond what I can control, though... I admit I've lost.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just what is up with this guy!?

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: Yep, that's a pretty common reaction to him. You see, his... more peculiar research was exactly what got him kicked out from the Fontaine Research Institute in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: My research was not peculiar...

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: Yeah yeah, and that's what you told the Ethics Committee back in the day as well. Don't think a single person bought what you said.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So... what was his research?

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: Ahem... If you wish to learn more about his research, you may go to the new Fontaine Research Institute to apply for access.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That gives Paimon a headache just thinking about it...

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: It's giving me a headache too. Even though he's been fired, the asset theft case I've been investigating still has to do with him...

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: Haha, do you want to ship me off to the Fortress of Meropide?

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: Well, that's not up to me to decide. The law will hand you your proper judgment. It's a shame that, unlike last time, we can't simply resolve matters by kicking you out.

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: Either way, thank you both for your help. I probably wouldn't have been able to bring him down myself... You can leave the rest to me. I promise that this time, he will receive his proper punishment.

dialogues.speaker: Bricole
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm afraid I'll still have to return to this place to continue my work. There are so many assets... Just how many reports would I have to compile...

dialogues.speaker: Coutrot
dialogues.text: Please believe me. All you need to do is stay in my place for a moment, and I'll be back from disabling the mechanism before you know it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... alright then. But be quick!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Very carefully, you swap places with Kuisel...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You wait for some time, but he doesn't come back as he promised. You also hear some strange voices...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You decide to try and find a way out of the cage...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But luckily, Paimon didn't end up getting locked in the cage with you... Uh... Paimon should be able to open the door the way we did before, right? Let's give it a try!

dialogues.speaker: Friendly Reminder
dialogues.text: Closing all valves will activate the terminal and open the path.

dialogues.speaker: Friendly Reminder
dialogues.text: Closing all valves will activate the terminal and open the path.
